# Project or agent documentation template

Use this outline when a new role or subsystem has a concrete implementation need. Fill it with real content; an empty scaffold does not establish a feature.

## Purpose and example

Describe the task, the intended user and one representative input/output example.

## Scope and current state

State what exists, what is experimental and what remains planned. Link to the owning architecture decision and implementation.

## Inputs, outputs and dependencies

Describe the relevant contracts, storage and interfaces. Keep credentials and private fixture content outside the document.

## Use and validation

Give commands from a named execution location, their expected results, and the tests or measurements relevant to this boundary.

## Limitations and next step

Name concrete limitations and one useful next outcome. Link to the shared roadmap instead of duplicating it.

Preserve [the template license](LICENSE) when reusing licensed template material.
